admission.justification: The cut and outside-knowledge populations can silently disappear from a passing candidate-only check; distinct assertion units protect counts, byte sums, bounded answers and unchanged operation actionability while human review decides causality.

applicability: Converted memory-quality landing reports for admitted leaf-base comparisons, and explicit migration comparisons using the same engine.
conditions: The check uses the admitted leaf memory base when supplied; comparison failure is named rather than silently represented as no cuts.
Measured cuts apply the shared at-least-eight removed lines and removed-greater-than-twice-added predicate; proven source deletion is exempt.
The added-file census excludes onboarding, knowledge, system and Git administrative metadata; the answer bounds rows while the complete report retains counts, paths and bytes.
exclusions: Automated judgment that removed text is false or that a cut/addition deserves acceptance.
A new refusing gate or actionable count contributed by the landing observations.
Restoring old cuts or removing developer-owned historic folders.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_landing_report.py (32 tests incl. answer-bound and role-text coverage); evidence5 126 cut cards / 351 added files at memory 38a0362d5; attempt-4 report; provenance-manifest.attempt-4.json

statement: A landing shows what it cuts from a card and what it adds beside the knowledge: measured cut cards and added files, report-only, with two counts in the tool answer.
